newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain Labour Min says majority of jobless under 35.
newsitem.headline: Spain Labour Min says majority of jobless under 35.

text.p: Spain's Labour Ministry said 53 percent of jobless registered by the employment institute INEM were under 35 and boasted a high level of education.
In a statement published on Saturday, the ministry said of this 53 percent, 46 percent were men and 59 percent were women who had higher levels of education that the rest of the population.
A survey found that 12.7 percent of unemployed said they had never worked before. Eight percent of unemployed said they had never studied and 21 percent said they had only finished primary studies.
Fifteen percent of those interviewed for the survey said they had taken up some form of study.

The Labour Ministry said the figures came from a survey carried out by the Centre for Sociological Investigations (CIS) between November 1996 and January 1997. A total of 4,658 unemployed people were interviewed.
